name: plate-lotions-coconut-breeze
prompt:
Take the three lotion bottles from this photo and place them on a plain, warm
sand-beige background (#EDE5D8), evenly spaced in a row, standing upright.

Soft natural studio lighting from upper left, with a gentle contact shadow under
each bottle. Generous empty space around them.

Keep each bottle exactly as photographed — identical label, identical wording,
identical proportions and cap. Do not redraw, restyle or re-letter the label.
Do not add any text, captions, logos or graphics to the image.
